independent_solve.reasoning: Golden rice is a genetically modified variety of rice (Oryza sativa) engineered to produce beta-carotene, a precursor of provitamin A. Consumption of this rice helps address vitamin A deficiency, which is a leading cause of childhood blindness in developing countries.

decisions.evidence: The question correctly identifies Golden rice as the biofortified crop engineered to produce beta-carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A to prevent blindness. The stored answer and solution are scientifically accurate.
decisions.student_reply: Golden rice is indeed the correct answer here. It was specifically engineered with beta-carotene to combat vitamin A deficiency, which is a major cause of preventable blindness in many parts of the world.
